text: Ilse Brandt. You're the one Hana brought in, so you won't have read anything yet.
I've read all of it. The sequences are correct. I am the part that goes wrong.
Back. The sequence is the same as last time. I am hoping I am not.
A league game? It goes on the board either way.
Fine. I'll be here. Page ninety-one.
You went outside the book. There's no follow-up written for that, because it isn't good.
It also beat me. I'm recording both facts.
That was the standard sequence, and it worked. I take no credit for it.
Come back and beat me with something that isn't in a book.
Three games. You play moves that aren't in any book, and half of them are better than the book.
Six. I've decided the books aren't the problem. I read them the way you'd read a timetable.
From now on I'm going to be wrong on purpose, sometimes, and see what happens.
